December 9, 2019 

Via Filing and Messenger  

Hon. Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC  20543 

Re:  U.S. Patent & Trademark Office v. Booking.com B.V., No. 19-46 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I  represent  the  respondent  in  the  above-captioned  matter.    I  write  to  request  an 

extension of time to file the briefs as follows: 

Brief of petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief of respondent:  

January 6, 2020 
February 12, 2020 

Both  parties  have  agreed  to  the  foregoing  schedule,  which  would  enable  this  case  to  be 
heard  during  the  Court’s  March  2020  sitting.    The  parties  believe  that  the  requested 
extension is appropriate given counsel’s other commitments, including preparing to present 
argument before this Court, and due to the upcoming holidays.  

Should you need any additional information from me, please do not hesitate to let 

me know. 

Yours sincerely, 

/s/ 

Lisa S. Blatt 

cc: Counsel for Petitioner
